subject: MedLytics pilot — sponsor alignment & procurement path
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Erin / Carlos — thanks again for a productive discussion today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we stay aligned with your exec team and procurement.

Key business outcomes you emphasized:
- Reduce inference cost per visit by ~45% for non-critical NLP workloads (billing analytics).
- Sub-150ms p95 latency target for the patient triage path (peak concurrency expected ~40 qps).
- Maintain PHI-friendly controls: VPC deployment option + KMS-managed keys and audit logs.

Primary pain points we heard:
- Current vendor's burst pricing is unpredictable and spikes during EOD batch windows.
- Limited visibility into token-level cost breakdown and model drift detection.
- Security team requires SOC2 evidence and a clear on-prem option for regulated trials.

Proposed pilot (high level):
1) 6-week pilot in your dev VPC: 2 model routes (low-cost 8-bit quantized for analytics, higher-precision for triage).
2) Redwood provides a cost/latency telemetry dashboard + weekly gating evals on the triage prompts.
3) Sprinted runbook for rollback and escalation to our Dedicated capacity if latency SLO is missed.

Immediate next steps (owners & dates):
- Redwood: Share Mutual Action Plan + draft SOW by Thu 8/6 — Vivek (attached).
- MedLytics: Share SOC2 assessor contact and procurement timeline by Mon 8/9 — Erin/Carlos.
- Redwood Security: Provide stub SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration notes by Fri 8/7 — Marissa.
- Exec alignment: 20–30 min sponsor briefing with Dr. Priya Shah week of 8/10 (you suggested Wed or Thu).

Risks / open questions:
- Procurement: any mandatory legal terms or a preferred master services agreement?
- Data residency: will any data need to remain on-prem for the pilot?

Attachments: mutual action plan PDF, pilot pricing grid (xlsx), brief SOC2 summary (stub).

If this looks right, I'll send the SOW + MAP and propose two times for the sponsor briefing.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
viv.k@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medlytics.com>

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Thanks, Vivek — this is great and captures the conversation cleanly. A few clarifications from our side:
- The 45% cost reduction is a target for the analytics route only; triage path accuracy is higher priority there.
- Procurement is running a vendor intake in parallel — target decision window is late September, but we can try to accelerate for a pilot in Aug/Sept.
- Our security lead, Carlos, will coordinate SOC2 evidence requests. Carlos, I'm looping you for procurement logistics and to confirm the preferred PO / contract flow.

Dr. Shah — we flagged Redwood to you as the prospective inference partner. Would you be available for a 20-minute sync on Thu 8/12 10:00–10:30 PDT or Fri 8/13 08:30–09:00 PDT? Either works for us.

Erin
Erin Walsh
VP Product | MedLytics
erin.walsh@medlytics.com | (415) 555-2400
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Great summary. A couple of operational notes from Security/PS standpoint: 
- I'll attach the SOC2 evidence index (stub) and a short checklist of the items your assessor typically asks for. That should accelerate the first pass.
- For the VPC pilot we usually provide a one-week onboarding window to establish network policies and a short ops playbook; can MedLytics allocate a cloud engineer for that window?
- Pricing grid attached shows two pilot options: standard and accelerated (the latter includes Dedicated burst capacity for p95 headroom). I'll flag margins for feasibility with Finance if you pick accelerated.

Open asks for MedLytics:
1) Confirm pilot contact for SRE/network (name + email).
2) Confirm whether PHI will be used in the pilot dataset (this affects the SOW and encryption posture).

I'll prepare the KMS integration notes and send the stub SOC2 artifacts by EOD Fri 8/7.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head, Security & Compliance (engagements) | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@medlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's discovery call

Marissa — thanks. Quick answers: 
- Procurement flow: we prefer a standard PO against an executed MSA, but for pilots procurement can accept a short SOW + PO if legal signs off. I'll confirm legal's preferred redline window (we typically allow 7 business days).
- SRE contact for pilot onboarding: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@medlytics.com> (cc'd on this thread).
- PHI: yes, a limited de-identified PHI set will be used for the analytics route; triage will use synthetic data initially.

On SOC2: I'll review your stub artifacts and loop in our assessor this week. Timeline: if we get the SOW in by 8/6 and SOC2 artifacts by 8/7, procurement can aim to issue a PO by 8/24. That keeps us on track for a Sept pilot start.

Carlos

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Priya Shah <priya.shah@medlytics.com>
Cc: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@medlytics.com>, Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@medlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor briefing: business outcomes, risks, and procurement path (short note)

Dr. Shah — thank you for making time. This is a short note ahead of the briefing to make sure we respect your priorities.

Business outcomes we will commit to demonstrate in the pilot (success criteria):
- Analytics route: 40–50% unit cost reduction vs. current provider on the selected billing reports with comparable throughput.
- Triage route: p95 latency <= 150ms and no >1% regression in triage accuracy on the gated eval set.
- Operational: clear audit trail (token-level cost), KMS-managed keys for any customer-provided secrets, and weekly quality gating reports.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: SOC2 evidence timeline could delay PO. Mitigation: Redwood provides a prioritized evidence index and direct assessor contact to speed validation.
- Risk: Unexpected latency under real concurrency. Mitigation: accelerated option (Dedicated burst) and an automated fallback policy to a higher-availability route.
- Risk: PHI handling disagreements. Mitigation: start analytics on de-identified PHI, triage on synthetic; expand only after legal sign-off.

Procurement path & escalation points:
- Preferred flow: execute short SOW + PO (target: PO by 8/24).
- If legal requires MSA redlines beyond 7 business days, Redwood's Sales Ops owner (Karthik Iyer) is the escalation point to coordinate concession approvals.
- For security gating, Marissa will be the primary contact and can escalate to Redwood's CISO for any policy exceptions.

I'll circulate the SOW + MAP (attached) and propose two times for the 20-minute sponsor briefing (Thu 8/12 10:00 PDT or Fri 8/13 08:30 PDT). Please let me know which you prefer.

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
